REJECT
The extraction preserves behaviour and drops `InScript` well below 15, but the new helpers hard-code parameter types (`Func<Family, bool>`, `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, bool>`, `IReadOnlySet<string>`) for `projectReset`, `keyframes` and `guards`, whose declarations aren't in the diff and which I couldn't check because the file isn't available here, so the build can't be confirmed (for example, it breaks if `GuardBindings` returns an `ISet<string>` or `Known` takes a concrete `Dictionary`).
